companyContext: American multinational corporation headquartered in Beaverton, Oregon, that designs, develops, manufactures and markets athletic footwear, apparel, equipment, accessories and services worldwide. NIKE, Inc. owns the Nike, Jordan and Converse brands.
brandContext: Nike is the flagship sportswear brand of NIKE, Inc., focused on innovative performance footwear, apparel and equipment for athletes across running, basketball, football, training, lifestyle and more. The 'Nouveautés' page on Nike France gathers all the brand's latest product launches (sneakers, apparel, accessories) for men, women and kids.

typography.fontUses: Logotype / wordmark — historical Nike lockup uses a customized Futura Bold Condensed Oblique

brandVision: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete in the world — if you have a body, you are an athlete. Nike empowers people through innovative products, services and experiences engineered for the future of sport.
brandValues: Innovation, performance, inclusivity, sustainability, athletic excellence, boldness, empowerment and a relentless 'Just Do It' mindset that pushes athletes (and everyone) to surpass their limits.
